boundary: Privacy / Confidentiality alone would be right if the packet contained only usernames or service names without saved passwords, so no working access to the accounts was handed over.
note: The assessor stated that all saved login records with passwords are sent externally, yet claimed no separate harm beyond confidentiality; the blind audit marks that claim unsupported, because handing over working passwords directly compromises every linked account. That misjudgment explains the missing Security / System Integrity.
